summary: Bounce light kept to the shade (screen-space sun test), hidden behind smoke and dust, multi-bounce, on vehicles.

rationale: The change is about where bounce light lands, so the tank is shot with its shaded side to the camera and the bounce-only panel shows the light on the hull side and skirts while the sunlit deck and lawn stay dark. The dust fix is about what must not show, so one three-way crop from a single run (off, laid over the dust, now) shows it at a glance. Golden hour and a night fire show it where it is strongest in a town; the pan clip answers whether it smears in motion. Midday and the 55 m command height were rendered too but are now faint, since sunlit ground no longer lifts, so they are not claimed. The command-height red shot answers whether a wall's colour reads from where a player usually looks; the room shot shows a doorway-lit interior with the roof lifted; the 60 fps golden-hour pans (full look and bounce alone) answer whether the light shimmers or crawls at the command height under motion. The squad clip answers whether the light boils or pumps as men walk through it, with the camera still.
